notes.title: 2.2.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed an issue where the names of each keys were not updated properly even after changing the contros in the options.

[*] You can now choose whether to stop the game from the pause screen.[/list]

notes.title: 2.2.3 Patch Note
notes.content: Fixed an issue that occurred when in keyboard/controller operation mode, where the downward direction input did not work when the helicopter was in takeoff.

notes.title: 2.2.0 ~ 2.2.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]2.2.0[/h2]
[list][*]Made easier to evade enemy anti-aircraft missiles.

[*]Added mouse button settings. You can now set the mouse sensitivity and the functions to be assigned to the left, right, and middle mouse buttons.

[*]DirectInput joysticks are now supported. (e. g. Logitech, Thrustmaster products)[/list]


[h2]2.2.1[/h2]
[list][*]Changed the number of magazines for the V245 20MM machine gun, the V860 30MM chain gun, and the V50 machine gun to 500, 650, and 700 respectively.

[*]Enemy submarines can now move while submerged.

[*]LCH-98D Sawfly Warrior's deception performance of flares has been weakened.

[*]Fixed the escorted friendly helicopter to land faster when it reaches the main base.

[*]The modeling of enemy interceptors has been replaced.[/list]


[h2]2.2.2[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed a frame-drop issue and various errors.[/list]

notes.title: 2.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Now SGM-976 Malathion can only be launched when it's locked on to enemy aircraft.

[*] SGM-976 Malathion's damage has been reduced.[/list]

notes.title: 2.1.0 & 2.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]2.1.0[/h2]
[list][*] Added anti-aliasing option.

[*] Fixed a bug where trees spawned over landing pads.

[*] Fixed an issue where the firing rates of 30mm and 20mm cannons of enemy helicopters were reversed.

[*] The turning power of the enemies' laser guided rockets has been reduced.

[*] The number of enemy units that can be spawned in Free Flight Mode has been increased to a maximum of 10 for each type.[/list]


[h2]2.1.1[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed a bug where buildings sometimes spawned on the sea.

[*] The turning power of enemy anti-aircraft missiles has been reduced.

[*] Enemies' flak cannon power has been reduced and its speed has been increased.[/list]

notes.title: 2.0.8 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed an issue with enemy interceptors firing missiles 4 times in a row. (should be 2 times)

[*] The height at which the aircraft automatically rises when the landing gear is folded has been lowered, making it easier to adjust the altitude.[/list]

notes.title: 2.0.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed some graphics bugs.

[*] Fixed an issue where the resolution option change was not applied.

[*] Slightly reduced the mobility of Blue Hornet.[/list]

notes.title: 2.0.6 Patch Note
notes.content: A language change option has been added to the game.

notes.title: 2.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Refuel speed in Air Patrol mode has been slightly increased.

[*] Now the version number will be displayed on the title screen.[/list]

notes.title: 2.0.4 Patch Note
notes.content: Reduced the speed of all aircraft and missiles, making it easier to operate your helicopter, fight enemy aircraft and dodge their missiles.

notes.title: 2.0.2 & 2.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]2.0.2[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where Steam Achievements were not obtainable.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game slows down on fullscreen mode.[/list]

[h2]2.0.3[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed a bug that prevented you from completing the tutorial.[/list]

notes.title: 2.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed some mission briefing typos in campaign mode.

[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the help messages from continuing when selecting a transport helicopter in practice mode.[/list]

notes.title: 2.0.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed a bug where helicopters' rotor shadows would not be displayed.

[*] The capacity of all helicopters has been reduced by 2 spaces.

[*] The fuel efficiency of Super Alcimus has been increased.

[*] Fixed a bug where a single mission all-clear message would appear when completing the 49th mission.[/list]

notes.title: 1.9.9 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Now each helicopter type has a different propeller length.

[*] Fixed the color of the explosion effect more naturally.

[*] Increased the delay of firing door guns mounted on enemy transport helicopters.[/list]

notes.title: 1.9.8 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] The flight performance of all helicopters has been improved to enable faster operation.

[*] 3 new bonus objectives have been added in the Air Patrol gamemode.[/list]

notes.title: 1.9.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] To make it easier to aim and adjust the altitude, the range of maximum nose cone operation is slightly reduced when playing with the keyboard and controller.

[*] Reduced the sensitivity of the analog stick when playing with the controller.

[*] Fixed a bug where controller vibration would not stop when returning to the title screen.

[*] The Anti-tank Missile's descending speed increased and its ascending speed decreased, making it easier to hit ground targets during hovering, but more difficult to hit enemy aircraft.[/list]

notes.title: 1.9.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Fixed a bug where torpedoes fired all at once.

[*] Super Alcimus' cannon firing speed has been reduced.

[*] The weight value of the helicopter has been lowered for a more stable flight.[/list]
